info.title: Khalid API
info.description: The Content API and the Admin API of a Khalid blog. Each key, and each address that sends wrong keys, has a limit a minute; past it the answer is 429 with Retry-After.

get.summary:
Lists how many readers each AI assistant sent in the last `days` days,
against the days before, with the pages they landed on. Needs
`settings:write`.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: From 1 to 366; 28 when left out.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

400.description: The days are not from 1 to 366

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

get.summary:
Lists the pages AI bots read in the last `days` days that no AI
assistant sent a reader to in the same days. Needs `settings:write`.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: From 1 to 90, the days the crawl log keeps; 30 when left out.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

200.description: The pages read but never cited

400.description: The days are not from 1 to 90

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

get.summary:
Counts the page views of the last `days` days, per day, source and
page, against the days before. Needs `settings:write`.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: From 1 to 366; 28 when left out.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

400.description: The days are not from 1 to 366

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

get.summary:
Lists who changed what through the Admin API and when, newest first:
every write that succeeded, to content, settings or staff accounts.
Needs `admin:all`.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
Only changes older than this one, by its `id`: the `next` of the
page before. Left out, the list starts at the newest.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: From 1 to 100; 50 when left out.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

400.description: The limit is not from 1 to 100, or before is not a number

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

get.summary:
Lists every author in every language. A site has tens, so the list
comes whole. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: This server keeps no authors

post.summary:
Creates an author in the language it names or the site's default.
Needs `posts:publish`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: This server keeps no authors

get.summary: Reads one author. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The language and slug, such as en.asif

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

put.summary:
Edits one author: only the fields sent change, and every post that
names them shows the change. The edit carries the `updated_at` of the
copy it was made on; when the author changed since, the answer is a
409 (RULES.md BL-API-7). Needs `posts:publish`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The language and slug, such as en.asif

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No author has this identity, or this server keeps no authors

409.description: The author changed after the copy the edit was made on

422.description: The body could not be read, or the name is empty

delete.summary:
Deletes one author. A post that still names them loses its byline.
The request names the `updated_at` of the copy it was made on; when the
author changed since, the answer is a 409. Needs `posts:publish`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The language and slug, such as en.asif

parameters.name: updated_at
parameters.description: The `updated_at` as last read, such as `2026-10-20T08:30:00Z`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

400.description: updated_at is missing or is not a time

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No author has this identity, or this server keeps no authors

409.description: The author changed after the copy the delete was made on

get.summary:
Lists drafts, scheduled posts and published posts by day from `from`
to `to`, at most 92 days, for the admin's calendar. Drafts with no date
and no schedule come under `undated`. To move a post to another day,
edit it: a new `date` for a draft, or `scheduled` with a new
`published_at`. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first day, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day, as `YYYY-MM-DD`, at most 92 days after `from`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

400.description: from or to is missing or not a date, from is after to, or they are more than 92 days apart

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

parameters.name: Accept-Version

Makes a content key or an integration key with the scopes it names.
The answer shows the key this once; keep it, because only its hash is

used again. The key making the request is kept, so nobody locks
themselves out. Needs `admin:all`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No working key has this identity

409.description: This is the key making the request

get.summary:
Lists the media library, newest upload first, with the shared list
grammar: `filter`, `order`, `limit` and `page` (RULES.md BL-API-5).
`filter=alt:null+kind:image` finds images still waiting for alt text.
Needs `media:write`.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: `filter=tag:news+featured:true`

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `include=authors,tags`

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: `fields=title,slug`

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `order=published_at desc,title`

parameters.name: formats
parameters.description: `formats=html,plaintext`

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: `limit=15` or `limit=all`

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: `page=2`

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

400.description: A list parameter could not be read

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

post.summary:
Adds the file sent as the body to the media library; its type is read
from its bytes. A file the library already has answers 200 with that
item, so a retry adds no second copy. Needs `media:write`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The file's name, made a slug; the extension comes from its content.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: The library folder, such as `guides/2026`. The top when left out.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

200.description: The library already had this file; the item as it is

400.description: The folder is not up to five slugs joined by /

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

422.description: The file is a type the library refuses, cannot be read, or is too large

get.summary:
Finds free photos on Unsplash or GIFs on GIPHY for a post, through the
blog, so the keys never reach the browser. Each search is off until the
owner turns it on in `site.toml`; without `words` the answer only says
which are on. Needs `media:write`.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: `unsplash` or `gifs`.

parameters.name: words
parameters.description:
The words to look for. Left out, the answer only says which
searches are on, without asking anyone.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page of results, from 1.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

200.description: Which searches are on, and the pictures found

400.description: The source or page could not be read

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

429.description: The source asks to wait before the next search

503.description: The search is off, has no key, or its source did not answer

post.summary:

a photo is used. The editor sends it when the writer picks a photo.
Needs `media:write`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: Unsplash has no photo with this identity

422.description: The body could not be read

503.description: Photo search is off, has no key, or Unsplash did not answer

parameters.name: id

parameters.name: Accept-Version

the same folder with the same name, alt text and caption. The original

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The picture's identity

parameters.name: Accept-Version

get.summary:
Lists posts in every status as rows of the admin's posts table, with
the shared query grammar (RULES.md BL-API-5); any field but `lint` may
be filtered and ordered by. A page holds at most 100 rows, because
each row's findings are counted. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: `filter=gate:refuses+status:draft`

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `order=updated_at desc`

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: `limit=15`, from 1 to 100

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: `page=2`

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

200.description: One page of posts in every status

400.description: A list parameter could not be read, names a field rows do not have, is not one the list takes, or is limit=all

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

post.summary:
Creates a draft post from markdown, or from HTML with `source=html`,
and answers with what the linter finds in it as it would go live and
where it opens in the admin (KH-API-6). A retry with the same
`Idempotency-Key` returns the post the first request made, so it never
makes two (RULES.md BL-API-7). Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: `html` to send the body as HTML; markdown otherwise.

schema.description: What a new post's body is written in.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any text up to 255 characters that names this request, so a retry makes no second post

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

201.description: The new draft, its lint findings and its admin path

400.description: The source is neither markdown nor html

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

409.description: Another post has the slug

422.description: The body could not be read

get.summary: Reads one post in any status. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The post's identity

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No post has this identity

put.summary:
Edits one post, and publishes it with `"status": "published"` once
the linter lets it through, or with `"status": "scheduled"` and a
future `published_at` at that time. The edit carries the `updated_at` of the copy it was
made on; when the post changed since, the answer is a 409 naming who
changed it and when (RULES.md BL-API-7). Needs `posts:write`, and
`posts:publish` to publish, schedule or take down a post, or to edit one
that is live or scheduled. Without `posts:publish`, an edit may move a
draft between `draft` and `in_review` but never leave it `ready`. A
change to head code needs an owner, an admin or `admin:all`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The post's identity

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

403.description: The key lacks posts:write, or posts:publish for an edit that publishes, schedules, takes down or changes a live post, leaves a post ready without posts:publish, or changes head code without being an owner or admin

404.description: No post has this identity

409.description: The post changed after the copy the edit was made on, or another post has the new slug

422.description: The body could not be read, a setting is not valid, the schedule cannot be kept, or the linter refused to publish the post

delete.summary:
Deletes one post in any status, with its file and its schedule. The
delete names the `updated_at` of the copy it was made on; when the post
changed since, the answer is a 409 naming who changed it and when
(RULES.md BL-API-7). Needs `posts:write`, and `posts:publish` for a
post that is live or scheduled.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The post's identity

parameters.name: updated_at
parameters.description: The `updated_at` as last read, such as `2026-10-20T08:30:00Z`.

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

400.description: updated_at is missing or is not a time

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

403.description: The key lacks posts:write, or posts:publish for a live or scheduled post

404.description: No post has this identity

409.description: The post changed after the copy the delete was made on

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The post's identity

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No post has this identity, or this server checks no posts

parameters.name: Accept-Version

reply in a thread, and tells the people in the thread and the site's
editors. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: id

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

The editor checks in every 20 seconds; someone who stops for a minute
lets go. The lock tells the editor who may type: the Admin API still
takes any edit and refuses a stale one with 409. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The post's identity

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

200.description: Who holds the lock, and who else has the post open

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No post has this identity

422.description: The body could not be read

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The post's identity

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No post has this identity

parameters.description: The post's identity

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

keeps the text it replaces in turn. Needs `posts:write`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The post's identity

parameters.name: Accept-Version
parameters.description: The oldest API version the client accepts, such as v1.0.

401.description: No valid integration key or staff token

404.description: No post has this identity, or this server keeps no versions

get.summary:
Lists every stored redirect, oldest first. Aliases in front matter are

AdminAiVisitors.description:
The readers AI assistants sent, per tool. The counts are page views,
not people, and never include AI bots.

arrivals.description: Every view that came from outside the site, AI search included.

first.description: The first day counted, in UTC.

last.description: The last day counted: today, in UTC.

tools.description:
Each assistant that sent readers in the period or the one before,
most views first.

AdminAttempt.description:
One try at sending a delivery: the receiver's status, or why it could
not be reached. Exactly one of the two is there.

reason.description: Why the receiver could not be reached.

status.description: The HTTP status the receiver answered; 200 to 299 is a success.

AdminAuthor.description:
An author in one language, in Admin API shape: everything their file
holds, which bylines, author pages and the author's schema show.

credentials.description: Why to trust the author, such as ten years in the field.

id.description: The language and the slug, such as `en.asif`.

name.description: The name readers see.

photo.description:
The photo: a file beside the author's file, a media path or a full
address.

role.description: What the author does, such as `Founder of SerpDad`.

same_as.description: The author's profiles elsewhere, in order.

slug.description: The slug posts name the author by in their `author` field.

updated_at.description: When the author's file last changed. An edit or delete sends it back.

AdminAuthors.description: Authors as the Admin API wraps them.

AdminCategories.description: Categories as the Admin API wraps them.

AdminCategory.description:
A category, in Admin API shape: one slug, named in each of the site's
languages, as one entry of `categories.toml` holds it.

id.description: The identity: the slug, the same in every language.

names.description: The name readers see, by language code.

posts.description: How many posts, drafts included, are in it.

slug.description: The slug posts name the category by in their `category` field.

updated_at.description:
When the site's categories last changed. An edit or delete sends it
back.

AdminChange.description: One change, as the Admin API shows it.

by.description: The identity of the key or staff account that made it.

id.description: Its place in the log: a later change has a larger number.

path.description: The address it was made at.

AdminChanges.description: One page of the audit log.

next.description: The `before` that lists the next page, or null on the last page.

AdminChecks.description: Checks as the Admin API wraps them.

AdminComment.description:
A comment in Admin API shape.

Exhaustive on purpose: the comments crate fills it in.

author_email.description:
The reader's email, when they gave one. Never shown on the site,
and never sent in a webhook.

id.description: Its identity.

parent.description: The comment it answers. Threads are one level deep.

post.description: The post it is on, by the post's file in the site folder.

text.description: What it says, as plain text with a line break between lines.

AdminComments.description: Comments as the Admin API wraps them.

AdminDeliveries.description: The newest deliveries of one webhook.

AdminDelivery.description: One message a webhook sent, with every try.

attempts.description: Every try so far, oldest first.

event.description: The event it announced, such as `post.published`.

id.description: Its place in the log: a later delivery has a larger number.

state_at.description: When the next try is due, or when it was delivered or given up.

AdminKey.description:
A key that works, in Admin API shape. The secret is shown once, when
the key is made, and never again.

id.description:
The key's identity, the part before its secret, such as
`1111222233334444`.

key.description:
The key itself. Only the answer that makes it holds it; keep it
then, because it is never shown again.

name.description: Who or what uses it, such as `SerpDad`.

role.description: A staff token's role, such as `editor`.

scopes.description: An integration key's scopes, such as `posts:write`.

AdminKeys.description: Keys as the Admin API wraps them.

AdminMedia.description: A file in the media library with the details kept beside it.

alt.description: What an image shows, for readers who cannot see it.

bytes.description: The size in bytes as stored.

focal_point.description: The part of an image every crop keeps.

folder.description: The library folder, or empty for the top.

height.description: The height in pixels, for images.

id.description: A hash of the uploaded bytes, the same for the same file.

name.description: The file name it is served under.

updated_at.description: When its details last changed. An edit sends this back.

width.description: The width in pixels, for images.

example.name: choosing-a-crm.jpg
example.alt: A sales team comparing two CRM dashboards on one screen

AdminMiss.description: An address that answered 404, as the Admin API shows it.

nearest.description:
The page "redirect this" would send it to, or null when no page is
near enough to guess.

AdminMisses.description: The 404 log as the Admin API wraps it.

AdminPage.description:
A page in one language, such as About, in Admin API shape. It is live
as soon as it is saved: pages have no drafts.

description.description: The text search engines show under the title, if set.

id.description: The language and the slug, such as `en.about`.

slug.description: The last part of the page's address.

updated_at.description: When the page last changed. An edit or delete sends it back.

AdminPageViews.description: The views of one page from one assistant.

AdminPages.description: Pages as the Admin API wraps them.

AdminPost.description:
A post in Admin API shape: any status, with its markdown source and
the `updated_at` an edit must send back (RULES.md BL-API-7).

author.description: The author's slug, matching a file in the site's `authors/` folder.

id.description: Stable across edits.

markdown.description: The markdown source, which the content file holds.

published_at.description: When it went or goes live; empty for a draft.

settings.description:
The settings beside the title and body, as the admin's settings
panel shows them.

slug.description: The last part of its address.

unpublish_at.description: When it comes down again, if it is scheduled to.

updated.description:
The day of the last real update readers see, which only an edit
with `real_update` moves. Empty until the first one.

updated_at.description: When it last changed. An edit sends this back unchanged.

updated_by.description: Who made the last change: a staff name or a key's identity.

updated_note.description: What changed in the last real update, shown beside its date.

AdminPosts.description: Posts as the Admin API wraps them.

AdminRedirect.description: A stored redirect as the Admin API shows it.

from.description: The path it starts from, or a regular expression over the path.

id.description: The identity to remove it by.

to.description:
Where a move leads: a path, a web address, or a pattern's template
with `$1` for its first group. Empty for 410 and 451.

AdminRedirects.description: Redirects as the Admin API wraps them.

AdminSchemaTemplate.description: One schema template as the Admin API sends and takes it.

applies_to.description: Whether `name` is a collection or a category.

name.description: The collection or category whose posts get the node.

properties.description:
Each property's value, by property name. A value may use the title
template variables, such as `{title}` and `{site}`.

AdminSettings.description:
The site's core settings from `site.toml`, in Admin API shape. The
running server reads `site.toml` once at start, so a change applies
after a restart.

address.description: The address of the main site, such as `https://www.example.com`.

default_language.description: The language a reader gets first, such as `en`.

languages.description: Every language the site is written in.

mount.description: The path the blog lives under, such as `/blog/`.

name.description: The site's name.

restart_needed.description:
Whether `site.toml` says something the running server does not use
yet, so a restart is needed to apply it.

updated_at.description: When `site.toml` last changed. A change sends it back.

AdminSnippet.description:
A snippet in one language, such as an affiliate disclosure, in Admin API
shape. A post places it by its slug, so a change shows in every post
that uses it as soon as it is saved.

id.description: The language and the slug, such as `en.affiliate-disclosure`.

slug.description: The slug a post names the snippet by.

title.description: The name shown in the editor.

updated_at.description: When the snippet last changed. An edit or delete sends it back.

AdminSnippets.description: Snippets as the Admin API wraps them.

before.description: Views in the period of the same length before.

source.description:
Where they came from: `direct`, `search`, `social`, `ai` (every AI
assistant), `other` (any other site) or `internal` (the site's own
pages).

AdminTag.description:
A tag in one language, in Admin API shape. A tag lives in the `tags`
of its posts, drafts included, so it exists while one post has it.

id.description: The language and the slug, such as `en.internal-links`.

name.description: The name as posts write it, such as `internal links`.

posts.description: How many posts, drafts included, have the tag.

slug.description: The slug made from the name, as the tag's page uses it.

updated_at.description:
When the last of those posts changed. A rename or removal sends it
back, so a post tagged since is never changed unseen.

AdminTags.description: Tags as the Admin API wraps them.

before.description: Views from its readers in the period of the same length before.

name.description: The assistant's name, for people.

pages.description: The pages its readers landed on, most views first, at most ten.

tool.description:
The assistant, for programs: `chatgpt`, `perplexity`, `gemini`,
`copilot`, `claude`, `deepseek`, `le-chat`, `meta-ai`, `grok`,
`you`, `phind`, or `unnamed` for views counted before tools were
named.

views.description: Views from its readers in the period.

AdminUncited.description:
The pages AI bots read but no AI assistant cited. A bot reading a page
is not a citation: only a reader arriving from an assistant is.

days.description: How many days were looked at.

first.description: The first day looked at, in UTC.

last.description: The last day looked at: today, in UTC.

AdminUncitedPage.description: One page AI bots read with no reader sent by an AI assistant.

bots.description:
The AI bots that read it, in alphabetical order, as their user
agents claimed.

reads.description: How many times AI bots read it.

AdminVisitors.description:
The page views `khalid serve` counted. A view is one page opened by a
person; bots never count.

arrivals.description: The views that came from outside the site.

first.description: The first day counted, in UTC.

last.description: The last day counted: today, in UTC.

pages.description: The most viewed pages, most views first, at most twenty.

per_day.description: The views per day, first day first, every day listed.

sources.description: The views per source, every source listed, outside ones first.

AdminWebhook.description: A webhook as the Admin API lists it. Its secret is never listed.

event.description: The event it sends, from the catalogue in `docs/standards/api.md`.

id.description: The identity to remove it by.

secret.description:
The secret every delivery is signed with. Only the answer that adds
the webhook carries it, once.

AdminWebhooks.description: Webhooks as the Admin API wraps them.

Alias.description:
An old address on this site that redirects to the post, such as
`/2019/05/old-title/`, so a moved post keeps its links.

url.description: The author's page on the blog, when it has one.

changelog.description: The entries on this page, or the one entry asked for.

collections.description: The entries on this page, or the one entry asked for.

title and description its `_index.md` gives, when it has one.

server's root like the `Location` header, such as
`/admin/posts/en.choosing-anchor-text`.

`null` when this server runs no linter or could not run it now. The
draft is saved either way.

corner, the scale focal points use.

as written. It is read as schema.org nodes before it is kept, so a page

A published post in API shape. Bodies are present only when asked for
with `formats`.

Every finding, as `khalid lint --json` prints them for one post,

PostEdit.description:
An edit to a post: the fields to change, and the `updated_at` of the
copy it was made on. Fields left out keep their value, and `null`
clears one that may be empty. A `status` of `published` publishes a
draft, once the linter lets it through; `scheduled` with a future
`published_at` publishes it then, and `draft` takes a scheduled post
off its schedule and a live post down.

author.description: A new author's slug, or `null` for none.

published_at.description:
When a `scheduled` post goes live: a time to come, with its offset,
such as `2026-11-03T09:00:00+01:00`.

oneOf.description:
Marks the edit as a real update to a live post's text, with a note
saying what changed: the post's `updated` date becomes today. Left
out, the date stays as it is, whatever else changes.
New values for some settings; the rest keep theirs.

slug.description: A new slug. No other post may have it.

status.description:
`published` to publish the post now, `scheduled` to publish it at
`published_at`, or `draft` to cancel a schedule and take a live post
down. Publishing runs
the linter, and a post with a blocking finding stays a draft.

unpublish_at.description:
When the post comes down again: a time to come, after
`published_at` for a scheduled post.

updated_at.description: The `updated_at` of the copy the edit was made on.

PostPresence.description: Who has a post open, as the one checking in sees it.

holder.description: Who holds the lock: the one person who may change the post now.

others.description: Everyone else with the post open, the earliest first.

yours.description: Whether the one checking in holds it.

gate.description:
Whether the lint publish gate lets it go live. A list filters by
this, such as `gate:refuses`.

index_status.description: Whether search engines may list it.

lint.description:
Its lint findings, counted. Counting takes every rule, so a list
counts only the rows on the page it sends, and cannot filter or
order by the counts.

published_at.description: When it went or goes live; empty for a draft.

review_due.description:
Whether the post is due for review: more than six months since it
was last reviewed or published, whichever came last. A list
filters by this, such as `filter=review:due`.

reviewed.description: The day it last came up for review (F3), if it ever has.

slug.description: The last part of its address.

updated_at.description: When it last changed.

PostRows.description: One page of the admin's posts table, as every list is wrapped.

PostSettings.description:
A post's settings beside its title and body. Every setting has a
value: empty lists, `false`, `draft` and `null` when never set.

access.description: Who may read the body: `public`, or `members`, who are signed in.

canonical.description: The address search engines should credit instead of this post.

co_authors.description: The other authors' slugs, after the author.

date.description: The day the post is dated, as shown to readers.

oneOf.description: The summary for cards, feeds and search results.
The image at the top of the post.

featured.description: Whether the post is featured in lists and the featured channel.

focus_keyword.description:
The one search phrase the post is written to answer, which the
linter checks the title, description and text against.

head_code.description:
Checked HTML added to the post's page head, such as an analytics
tag. Only owners and admins may change it.

password_protected.description:
Whether a reader must give a password to read the body. The
password itself is never sent back.

review_state.description: Where the post stands in review.

reviewed.description:
The day the post last came up for review and was looked at (F3).
A review that changes nothing sets this alone; it never moves
`date`, and a real change is what sets `updated` in the front
matter.

robots.description: The post's own robots directives, in place of the site's.

oneOf.description:
Hand-written JSON-LD the page carries beside the schema Khalid
writes, for a type Khalid does not write itself.

The title search results show, in place of the site's title
template, or `null` for the template's.

share_cards.description: How the post looks when shared on X and Facebook.

The theme template the post is shown with, such as `wide` for
`theme/templates/post-wide.html`, or `null` for `post.html`.

PostVersion.description:
A post's title and text as they were saved, before a later edit
replaced them.

saved_at.description: When this title and text were saved.

saved_by.description:
Who saved them, as the post named them; `null` when not known, such
as for a file written by hand.

PostVersions.description: Earlier versions, wrapped the way the Admin API wraps resources.

who.description: Who, as the post's `updated_by` names them.

`https://www.example.com/blog/preview/en.choosing-anchor-text/?until=1793696400&sig=...`.

PreviewLinks.description: Preview links, wrapped the way the Admin API wraps resources.

Problem.description:
An error as the API sends it (RULES.md BL-ERR-5): `type`, `title`,
`status` and `detail`, plus `fix`, and `rule` and `instance` where they
apply. `detail` and `fix` come from a [`UserMessage`], so they say what
happened, why it matters and what to do (BL-ERR-4).

detail.description: What happened and why it matters.

instance.description: The address the problem is about.

lint.description:
For a post the linter refused, every finding, as `khalid lint
--json` prints them for one post, and the post's `score` out of 100
with the rules that cost it points.

rule.description: The lint rule or parameter that produced the problem.

title.description: The same short title for every problem of this kind.

type.description: A link to the page that explains this kind of problem.

RealUpdate.description:
An edit's claim that it is a real update: it changes what a live post
says, and `note` tells readers what. Only then does the post's
updated date become today. Title, description and settings edits
alone never move it.

note.description:
What changed, in one short sentence, such as "Refreshed the 2024
numbers." Shown beside the updated date. At most 160 characters.

RedirectExplanation.description: Why an address answers what it answers: the debug view.

hops.description: Each hop from the address to the end of its chain.

matched.description: The identity of the stored redirect it matched, if any.

status.description: The one status a visitor gets, if a redirect matched.

to.description: Where a visitor is sent in one step, for a move.

RedirectMiss.description: The address to redirect, and where to.

resolved.description: `true` once the thread is dealt with, `false` to open it again.

is needed before previews and served pages show these.
